bug_semantics: Request.form(max_fields=..., max_part_size=...) forwarded both limits to MultiPartParser for multipart/form-data but constructed FormParser without either limit for application/x-www-form-urlencoded. FormParser synchronously accumulated every field name and value and appended every field without a size or count check, so an unauthenticated oversized urlencoded field caused body-proportional memory allocation and many small fields caused CPU/event-loop denial of service despite the caller-supplied limits.
flaw_origin: The urlencoded parsing path and its unbounded FormParser accumulators were first written by PR #102 member 65a0abd755b412572c94f7d29ba8391045f0fad6 and landed on the main branch through squash commit c43a070eedc1f5993d84cd06643920b962761adc. The member's immediate parent 85029b51c153944ed928d7ca3e04f22a5fe80863 has no FormParser and no application/x-www-form-urlencoded dispatch, establishing first-write absence in the parent.
ai_marker: No AI marker appears on the atomic BIC: commit 65a0abd755b412572c94f7d29ba8391045f0fad6 is authored and committed by Tom Christie on 2018-10-12, has the human commit message 'Add FormParser', and has no Co-authored-by, Generated-by, Assisted-by, bot, model, or tool trailer.
evidence: GitHub advisory GHSA-82w8-qh3p-5jfq and the published CVE-2026-54283 record both identify affected versions >=0.4.1,<1.3.1, fixed version 1.3.1, and the missing urlencoded max_fields/max_part_size enforcement; neither record is withdrawn or rejected.

Main-branch squash c43a070eedc1f5993d84cd06643920b962761adc contains the resulting code.

The direct fix member ffeda64b56df5082f32913d0ec819727c38d06b7 and public squash dba1c4babc4f99ad2622bb913d87045775dda735 have the same tree and parent; they add both limits to FormParser, enforce field count and combined name/value size while parsing, forward Request.form limits, and add rejection tests. The public fix is absent from 1.3.0 and present in 1.3.1.
